newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GF PROPS POSSIBLE BUY-IN CAUTIONARY RENEWED.
newsitem.headline: GF PROPS POSSIBLE BUY-IN CAUTIONARY RENEWED.

text.p: Gold Fields Property Co Ltd renewed a previous cautionary announcement saying that its major shareholder was in the process of receiving and evaluating offers for the purchase of its shareholding in the firm.

Should a satisfactory offer be received, it was anticipated that a final agreement could be concluded by the middle of July, GF Props said. In this event the offer to minority shareholders would be made within a month of such agreement being reached.
Shareholders should accordingly continue to exercise caution when dealing in the shares of the firm, GF Props said.
